5 تحلّب It flowed; (S, A, K, KL;) [or oozed, or exuded;] said of milk; (KL;) and (tropical:) of water; (A;) and (tropical:) of sweat, (S, A, K,) as also ↓ انحلب ; (S;) and (tropical:) of moisture, or dew. (L.) ―
-b2- (tropical:) It (one's body) flowed, عَرَقًا with sweat: and in like manner, the eye [with tears]; (K;) and the mouth [with saliva]; (A, K;) as also ↓ انحلب . (K.) ―
-b3- (assumed tropical:) He sweated. (TA.) ―
-b4- It is also said of the [tribute termed] فَىْء [as meaning (assumed tropical:) It flowed in; or was collected: see حَلَبٌ]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
